compositing_protocol.rationale: Chlorophyll-a concentration in marine ecosystems follows a log-normal distribution (Campbell, 1995). Arithmetic mean biases composites toward episodic blooms.
compositing_protocol.case2_water_masking: ETOPO1 depth <= 5m excluded to eliminate benthic reflection and suspended sediment contamination.
